tests.name: Packet Capture Linux using tshark or tcpdump
tests.description:
Perform a PCAP. Wireshark will be required for tshark. TCPdump may already be installed.

Upon successful execution, tshark or tcpdump will execute and capture 5 packets on interface ens33.

tests.name: Packet Capture FreeBSD using tshark or tcpdump
tests.description:
Perform a PCAP. Wireshark will be required for tshark. TCPdump may already be installed.

Upon successful execution, tshark or tcpdump will execute and capture 5 packets on interface ens33.

tests.name: Packet Capture macOS using tcpdump or tshark
tests.description:
Perform a PCAP on macOS. This will require Wireshark/tshark to be installed. TCPdump may already be installed.

Upon successful execution, tshark or tcpdump will execute and capture 5 packets on interface en0A.

tests.name: Packet Capture Windows Command Prompt
tests.description:
Perform a packet capture using the windows command prompt. This will require a host that has Wireshark/Tshark
installed.

Upon successful execution, tshark will execute and capture 5 packets on interface "Ethernet".

tests.name: Windows Internal Packet Capture
tests.description:
Uses the built-in Windows packet capture
After execution you should find a file named trace.etl and trace.cab in the temp directory

tests.name: Windows Internal pktmon capture
tests.description:
Will start a packet capture and store log file as t1040.etl.
https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/Pktmon/

tests.name: Windows Internal pktmon set filter
tests.description:
Select Desired ports for packet capture 
https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/Pktmon/

tests.name: Packet Capture macOS using /dev/bpfN with sudo
tests.description: Opens a /dev/bpf file (O_RDONLY) and captures packets for a few seconds.

tests.name: Filtered Packet Capture macOS using /dev/bpfN with sudo
tests.description: Opens a /dev/bpf file (O_RDONLY), sets BPF filter for 'udp' and captures packets for a few seconds.

tests.name: Packet Capture FreeBSD using /dev/bpfN with sudo
tests.description: Opens a /dev/bpf file (O_RDONLY) and captures packets for a few seconds.

tests.name: Filtered Packet Capture FreeBSD using /dev/bpfN with sudo
tests.description: Opens a /dev/bpf file (O_RDONLY), sets BPF filter for 'udp' and captures packets for a few seconds.

tests.name: Packet Capture Linux socket AF_PACKET,SOCK_RAW with sudo
tests.description: Captures packets with domain=AF_PACKET, type=SOCK_RAW for a few seconds.

tests.name: Packet Capture Linux socket AF_INET,SOCK_RAW,TCP with sudo
tests.description: Captures packets with domain=AF_INET,type=SOCK_RAW,protocol=TCP for a few seconds.

tests.name: Packet Capture Linux socket AF_INET,SOCK_PACKET,UDP with sudo
tests.description:
Captures packets with domain=AF_INET,type=SOCK_PACKET,protocol=UDP for a few seconds.
SOCK_PACKET is "obsolete" according to the man page, but still works on Ubuntu 20.04

tests.name: Packet Capture Linux socket AF_PACKET,SOCK_RAW with BPF filter for UDP with sudo
tests.description:
Captures packets with domain=AF_PACKET,type=SOCK_RAW for a few seconds.
Sets a BPF filter on the socket to filter for UDP traffic.

tests.name: PowerShell Network Sniffing
tests.description:
PowerShell Built-in Cmdlets to capture network traffic.
